generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as category-1 certificate as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions as per Notice Inviting tender

technicalCriterionList.description: To Qualify for award of this contract the Tenderer must have valid Class - 4 and above Civil Contractors Registration Certificate, registered in KPWD / MES / CPWD as on the Date of Tender Notification. Scanned copy of Valid contractors Registration Certificate.
To qualify for award of this contract, the tenderer must have a Category-1 Certificate. Scanned copy of self attested valid Category-1 certificate issued by competent authority.

To qualify for award of this contract, the tenderer must have a financial turnover Certificate. Scanned copy of year wise financial turnover. (Certified by Chartered Accountant only. Statement issued by others will not qualify for eligibility).

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

technicalCriterionList.description: To Qualify for award of this contract the assessed available tender capacity of the tenderer should be more than the amount put to tender. Note: The bid capacity of the tenderer is calculated based on the formula. Assessed Available Tender Capacity : ( (A X N x 5) - B) Where A : Maximum value of Civil Engineering works, updated to 2025-26 price level, executed in any one year during the last five years.( Completed as well as works in progress ). B : Value at 2025-26 price level of existing commitments and ongoing works to be completed during the next two years. N : Number of years prescribed for completion of the work for which tender is invited. 5 : Multiplying factor for assessing the available tender capacity for works costing upto Rs.100.00Lakhs. The Bidder/Contractor must upload the Scanned copy of details of existing commitments and ongoing works to be completed in the prescribed format only (Annexure-B) duly signed. In case the Bidder does not have any existing commitments, the same should be indicated as NIL in the prescribed format, duly signed. Details uploaded in any other format or uploaded documents in which the Bidder himself has calculated the Bid capacity will not be considered for evaluation and also will not qualify for eligibility.

itemList.description:
Providing and fixing Steel work welded in built up sections/ framed
work, including cutting, hoisting, fixing in position and applying a priming coat of approved steel primer using structural steel etc. as required. In gratings, frames, guard bar, ladder, railings, brackets, gates and similar works including cost of materials, labour, usage charges of machinery complete as per specifications and as per directions of the Engineer-in-Charge. CSR 2023-24/Vol.2/P84/11.25.2

Providing and fixing Chlorinated Polyvinyl Chloride (CPVC) pipes, having thermal stability for hot & cold water supply, including all CPVC plain & brass threaded fittings, including fixing the pipe with clamps at 1.00 m spacing. This includes jointing of pipes & fittings with one step CPVC solvent cement and testing of joints complete as per direction of Engineer in Charge. Internal work - Exposed on wall. 25 mm nominal dia Pipes. CSR 2023-24/Vol.2/P122/13.31.3

Providing and fixing Chlorinated Polyvinyl Chloride (CPVC) pipes, having thermal stability for hot & cold water supply, including all CPVC plain & brass threaded fittings, including fixing the pipe with clamps at 1.00 m spacing. This includes jointing of pipes & fittings with one step CPVC solvent cement and testing of joints complete as per direction of Engineer in Charge. Internal work - Exposed on wall. 20 mm nominal dia Pipes. CSR 2023-24/Vol.2/P122/13.31.2

Providing flooring with 25mm thick polished Cuddapah slabs using cement mortar 1:6, 25mm thick over existing cement concrete bed or top of roof laid to line and level and jointed with cement slurry mixed with pigment to match the shade of the slab , including cost of materials, labour, curing, polishing complete as per specifications. CSR 2023-24/Vol.2/P64/9.36

Providing and fixing Chlorinated Polyvinyl Chloride (CPVC) pipes, having thermal stability for hot & cold water supply, including all CPVC plain & brass threaded fittings, including fixing the pipe with clamps at 1.00 m spacing. This includes jointing of pipes & fittings with one step CPVC solvent cement and testing of joints complete as per direction of Engineer in Charge. Internal work - Exposed on wall. 32 mm nominal dia Pipes. CSR 2023-24/Vol.2/P122/13.31.4

Painting with synthetic enamel paint of approved brand and manufacture of required colour to give an even shade :Two coats on new work over an under coat of suitable shade with ordinary paint of approved brand and manufacture after thoroughly brooming the surface to remove all dirt, dust, mortar drops and foreign matter including preparing the surface even and sand paper smooth, cost of materials, labour complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge. CSR 2023-24/Vol.2/P48/8.41

Providing and laying water proofing treatment to the Rafts, Below grade
slab, Lift pits, water retaining structures with fully bonded High Density Polyethlene Membrane (HDPE) of 1.2mm composite thickness and having tensile strength of greater than 25 MPa (as per ASTM D 412), elongation of greater than 500% (as per ASTM D 412), puncture resistance of greater than1000N (as per ASTM E 154), peel adhesion to concrete greater than1200N/m (as per ASTM D 903), hydrostatic head resistance greater than 70m (as per ASTM D 5385). The system should be fully bonded to the RCC thereby conforming to IS 16471:2017 requirements of UG waterproofing structures. The membrane should be minimum 2.4m wide to reduce the number of joints with minimum 75mm factory made selvedge’s and comprising of an HDPE layer and a pressure sensitive adhesive layer which is covered by a weather proof protective and trafficable granular layer to protect self-adhesive polymer layer, etc,
including surface preparation completely as per specification. CSR 2023-24/Vol.2/P150/15.5
Engaging labour for cleaning Bus stand surroundins. CSR 2023-24/Vol.1/PA49/IV
